name: gameanything
description: Turn your photos, memories, novels and films into playable mods for games you own: Minecraft, Stardew Valley, Cities: Skylines, Slay the Spire and more. Guides the agent through the whole GameAnything workflow with the gameanything CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any inspiration into a playable game world
interface.longDescription: Guides the agent through reading your photos, videos, novels or films on your computer, choosing what matters with you on cards in a browser UI, then building, playtesting and fixing a mod for your own copy of the game, round after round.
defaultPrompt: Turn my wedding photos into a Stardew Valley mod
